// Fixture — should be flagged.
//
// A second exported *Service method shape: Update takes multiple
// params including a literal `string` slug, reaches core.PathJoin
// in its body, and never calls IsValidID. Proves the rule fires
// on any-param-is-string, not just sole-string-arg methods.

package fixture

type UpdateResult struct {
	OK bool
}

type Service struct{}

func PathJoin(parts ...string) string {
	out := ""
	for _, p := range parts {
		out += p + "/"
	}
	return out
}

// Update is exported, takes a string slug + an int version, and
// reaches PathJoin directly in its body without IsValidID.
func (s *Service) Update(slug string, version int) UpdateResult {
	_ = version
	dir := PathJoin("/data", slug)
	_ = dir
	return UpdateResult{OK: true}
}
